Model transfer: uniform draws in [0,1] have densities, so the finitely many proper algebraic bad sets and proper conditional hyperplanes have probability zero. Exceptional dimensions, noninvertibility and invalid blocks can be guarded and return failure within the same polynomial budget. This verifies the weaker success probability 2/3 without claiming a finite-bit-randomness or conditioning theorem.
